notes.title: Community multiplayer sessions starting this Saturday
notes.notes:
To help you in finding opponents during early access, regular multiplayer sessions will be held on a weekly basis. Every skill level is welcome! Chances are that you will be able to find us there too.

The time and day of the first occasion:
August 1st, 2020 (Saturday)
18:00 CEST (UTC+2)

If you have any questions, or you would like to suggest a different starting time for the next week, visit us at: http://discord.lost-bazaar.org/

notes.title: Early Access Begins!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38260851/cd0ac052a523a068a31530912cd19665cfeae765.gif[/img]

We are happy to announce that after a long (definitely longer than expected) development time, the Bazaar has finally opened its gates. The time where anyone can grow rich from selling utensils, clothing, and antique bric-a-bracs has come!

When the very first item, the Ruler, was made in October 2011, "Lost Bazaar" was still well on its way to become a tabletop boardgame -- therefore we can undoubtedly say that the game and our vision for it have changed greatly over time. However, the goal has always remained the same: to create a deceptively simple-looking, easily learnable and carefully balanced card-game that is able to confidently fill its own niche in the genre.

Naturally, the open beta is only the beginning of the Lost Bazaar's journey: we still have many ideas on how to improve the game and make it more fun. In the next phase, we greatly count on our players' (that's you) feedback to do so and we hope that we can share our love for the game with you.

Have fun!
The Lost Bazaar Team
